items.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
items.body: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure through Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism.

items.title: Ethereum Privacy Network Aztec Rolls Out Major Security and Speed Upgrade
items.body: The “Tierra” upgrade resolves a critical bug from the prior version, adds formal verification, and an AI-powered testing harness.

items.title: Morning Minute: Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish for Ethereum
items.body: Meanwhile, both the BTC ETFs and ETH ETFs bleed outflows in the Binance hack aftermath, dragging down prices.

items.title: ETHGas wants to bring Wall Street to public Ethereum with institutional controls
items.body: The proposed service would offer sanctions screening and qualified validators, but current compensation for failed commitments is set at zero.

items.title: Bitmine Buys More Ethereum as Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish
items.body: The chairman laid out six reasons the market’s “muted” 4% ETH drop after the record Binance theft shows crypto is “increasingly resilient,” as the firm’s stash neared its 5% supply goal.

items.title: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
items.body: Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.
